0000_core_platform.note: Clean development baseline for shared platform, identity, authorization, audit, tenant context, RLS, and security infrastructure. Rebuild development databases from zero; production recovery remains restore/forward-compensation only.

0001_customer.note: Customer-domain baseline. Rebuild development databases from zero; production recovery remains restore/forward-compensation only.

0002_sales.note: Sales-domain baseline. Cross-domain foreign keys to later Inventory objects are applied by the Inventory migration. Rebuild development databases from zero; production recovery remains restore/forward-compensation only.

0003_inventory.note: Inventory-domain baseline, including deferred Sales-to-Inventory foreign keys. Rebuild development databases from zero; production recovery remains restore/forward-compensation only.

0004_procurement.note: Procurement-domain baseline. Rebuild development databases from zero; production recovery remains restore/forward-compensation only.

0005_finance.note: Finance-domain baseline. Rebuild development databases from zero; production recovery remains restore/forward-compensation only.

0006_tax.note: Tax-domain baseline. Rebuild development databases from zero; production recovery remains restore/forward-compensation only.

0007_platform_tenant_delete_lifecycle.note: Corrects the platform tenant guarded soft-delete procedure to use the canonical cancelled lifecycle state, maintain soft-delete timestamps, and block deletion while protected tenant data or audit history remains. Recovery is forward-only or restore from backup.
